slug: 杂役都是仙帝你管这叫没落宗门
lines: “休息一日，明天出发。”
让苏怜心退下后，林玄便是迫不及待的开始修炼起了天魔影。
至于聚天玄丹，林玄不打算现在用。
而是打算突破王境时再用。
突破王境所需要的灵力极为恐怖，上次林玄尝试突破王境，几乎消耗完了所有身家，如今虽还没有开始冲击，但也得提前准备好所需要的丹药。
这一次冲击王境，可不同于上次。
上次只不过是尝试领悟一条大道冲击王境。
但这一次，是整整二十二条大道！
所需要的灵力之恐怖，虽不说是上一次的二十二倍，但至少也是五六倍，林玄得做好充足的准备。
别到时候因灵力不够突破失败，林玄哭都没地方哭去。
而就在林玄参悟天魔影时，在外的王焱，却是在城中一处食楼内，碰到了几位熟人。
“红儿？”
顺着王焱视线望去，食楼大厅的一处角落的圆桌之上，坐着五六人，其中一名女子，身着一身深红色长裙，虽长相算不上多美，但身材极好，从周围那些食客是不是瞟来的目光中便足以看出。
听到有人叫自己的名字，红裙女子顿时抬头看来，也看到了王焱。
“焱哥？”
声音中，带着一抹意外和惊喜，显然是没想到，在这里能碰到王焱。
位于红裙女子身旁的几人，也看到了王焱，而他们看到王焱时，神色间浮现的却不是惊喜，反而是皱起了眉头。
“我当是谁呢，原来是王焱小子啊，这是也要前往焚天秘境？”红裙女子身旁的一位，与她有几分神似的中年男子，缓缓开口，声音算不上冷淡，但跟热情也搭不上边。
王焱点了点头。
王焱出身于唐清王国边隅的一座名为云汐城的小城。
城不大，势力却不少，云汐城有八大家族，王焱所在的王家便是其中之一，而红裙女子所在的李家，也是其中之一。
其身旁那与她有几分神似的中年，便是红儿的父亲，李元，也是李家家主。
不过，不一样的是，八大家族中王焱所在的王家位列第七，而李家，则位列第二。
红儿本名为李红，和王焱自小青梅竹马，彼此相爱，早已私定终身，但李元和李家内部，一直有些反对两人在一起。
反对也是正常，李家位列云汐城八大家族第二，不管是家族产业，还是族中强者，整体实力都要胜过王家很多，李红身为李家家主之女，嫁给王焱绝对算是下嫁了，李家之中，包括李元在内，都一致认为王焱配不上李红。
相比之下，城主府的杨松杨公子，在李元看来才是自家女儿的良配，不仅是城主长子，更是自小展现出非同一般的天资，放眼整个云汐城，年轻一辈中无人能出其右。
最主要的是，对方对自家女儿也极有好感。
相比之下，王焱在他眼里，比起那位城主长子杨松，差了何止一筹。
若非李红一口咬死非王焱不嫁，李元才不得已同意了两人之事。
哪怕在一年前，得知王焱拜入青阳剑宗，且拜了一位劫境七重为师，李元也不曾改变自己的想法。
反而更加后悔了。
原因无他，就在不久前，那位城主长子，因天资不凡，被玄极宗六长老收为了亲传弟子……
玄极宗，和青阳剑宗一样，同为唐清帝国十大宗门之一，且排名还在青阳剑宗之上。
玄极宗六长老，那可是货真价实的王境强者。
得知这一消息后，李元别提多后悔了。
如果当初自己不心软，没准李家已经抱上了城主府这条大腿了。
被一位王境强者收为亲传，

“李叔，可是遇到了什么难事？”
先前王焱便注意到了，李家一群人坐在一起，桌上的菜都凉了也不吃，话也不说，一副心不在焉的模样。
“还不是那人太过分了！”
说到这里，李红便是气不打一处来。

"Have a day off and set off tomorrow."
After asking Su Lianxin to retreat, Lin Xuan couldn't wait to start practicing the Sky Demon Shadow.
As for the Jutian Xuan Dan, Lin Xuan doesn't plan to use it now.
But I plan to use it when I break through to the King Realm.
The spiritual power required to break through to the King's Realm is extremely terrifying. The last time Lin Xuan tried to break through to the King's Realm, he almost consumed all his wealth. Now, although he hasn't started the attack yet, he still has to prepare the required pills in advance.
This time the attack on the King Realm was different from the last time.
Last time, I was just trying to understand a way to attack the King Realm.
But this time, there are twenty-two avenues!
The amount of terrifying spiritual power required was not twenty-two times that of the last time, but it was at least five or six times greater. Lin Xuan had to be fully prepared.
Don't fail to break through because of insufficient spiritual power. Lin Xuan will have no place to cry.
While Lin Xuan was attending Wu Tian Mo Ying, Wang Yan, who was outside, met several acquaintances in a restaurant in the city.
"Hong'er?"
Following Wang Yan's line of sight, there were five or six people sitting on a round table in a corner of the restaurant hall. One of them was a woman, wearing a dark red dress. Although she was not very beautiful, she had a very good figure, which could be seen from the glances of the surrounding diners.
When she heard someone calling her name, the woman in the red dress immediately looked up and saw Wang Yan.
"Brother Yan?"
There was a touch of surprise and surprise in the voice, and it was obvious that he did not expect to meet Wang Yan here.
Several people next to the woman in the red dress also saw Wang Yan, and when they saw Wang Yan, their expressions were not surprise, but frowns.
"Who do I think you are? It turns out to be Wang Yan. Are you going to the Burning Heaven Secret Realm?" A middle-aged man next to the woman in the red dress, who looked somewhat similar to her, spoke slowly. His voice was not cold, but it did not match the enthusiasm.
Wang Yan nodded.
Wang Yan was born in a small city called Yunxi City on the edge of the Tang and Qing Kingdom.
The city is not big, but it has a lot of power. There are eight major families in Yunxi City. The Wang family where Wang Yan belongs is one of them, and the Li family where the woman in the red dress belongs is also one of them.
The middle-aged man next to her who somewhat resembled her was Hong'er's father, Li Yuan, who was also the head of the Li family.
However, the difference is that among the eight major families, Wang Yan's Wang family ranks seventh, while the Li family ranks second.
Hong'er's real name is Li Hong. She and Wang Yan have been childhood sweethearts and have been in love with each other since childhood. They have already been secretly committed to each other for life. However, there has always been some opposition within Li Yuan and the Li family to the two of them being together.
It is normal to object. The Li family ranks second among the eight major families in Yunxi City. Whether it is the family business or the strongest members of the family, the overall strength is much better than that of the Wang family. As the daughter of the head of the Li family, marrying Wang Yan is definitely considered a downfall. The Li family, including Li Yuan, all believe that Wang Yan is not worthy of Li Hong.
In contrast, Young Master Yang Song of the City Lord's Mansion, in Li Yuan's opinion, is a good match for his daughter. Not only is he the eldest son of the City Lord, but he has also shown extraordinary talent since he was a child. Looking at the entire Yunxi City, no one among the younger generation can match him.
The most important thing is that the other party also has a great affection for his daughter.
In comparison, in his eyes, Wang Yan was far worse than Yang Song, the eldest son of the city lord.
If Li Hong hadn't killed Wang Yan and refused to marry him, Li Yuancai had no choice but to agree to their affair.
Even a year ago, Li Yuan never changed his mind when he learned that Wang Yan had joined the Qingyang Sword Sect and had a seventh-level tribulation realm as his teacher.
Instead, I regretted it even more.
There is no other reason. Not long ago, the eldest son of the city lord was accepted as a direct disciple by the Sixth Elder of Xuanji Sect due to his extraordinary talent...
Xuanji Sect, like Qingyang Sword Sect, was one of the ten major sects in the Tang and Qing Empire, and ranked above Qingyang Sword Sect.
The Sixth Elder of Xuanji Sect is a genuine King Realm powerhouse.
After learning the news, Li Yuan didn't regret it much.
If I hadn't been soft-hearted back then, maybe the Li family would have embraced the City Lord's Mansion.
Being accepted as a personal successor by a king-level expert,
